expectations.text: Recommends co-locating a type with the module that owns it as the default (not a central types.ts)
expectations.evidence: 'Co-locate types with the code that owns them... A type used by exactly one module → define it in that module's file. This is the single highest-value move.' Moves away from central types.ts.

expectations.text: Reframes 'single source of truth' as defined-once, not all-in-one-file
expectations.evidence: 'The truth you care about is the definition exists once — not all definitions live in one file.'

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely shared/global types in a shared or feature-level file (does NOT advise one-type-per-file scattering)
expectations.evidence: Feature folder for shared, global types split by domain; 'Co-location isn't "one type per file" — it's "the type lives with its owner."'

expectations.text: Grounds it in the agent skipping the cross-file lookup (the central types file is the sibling it won't open)
expectations.evidence: 'they're reluctant to go look at other files... the type it needs is never in the file — it's always one hop away in types.ts... the hop Claude Code is most likely to skip.'
